question: Select the correct option to fill blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is - **when**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The passage discusses theories about why people yawn.**
 
• The conjunction should indicate the time or condition under which the action occurs.
 
• "**When**" fits well as it denotes the time at which something happens.
 
• Therefore, the correct word for blank no. 2 is** 'when.'**

Hence the correct statement from the passage is **"****Some people believe that we yawn when__ we do not have enough oxygen in our bodies. "**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("as", "why", "while") do not fit as naturally in this context as "when" does.

 
• **As (जैसे ही)**: "As" denotes causation or simultaneity, but "when" is more appropriate here as it indicates the specific condition.
 
• **Why (क्यूं)**: "Why" seeks a reason or explanation and does not fit grammatically in this context.
 
• **While (जबकि)**: "While" indicates simultaneity or contrast, which also does not suit the causative context.
